html:
Let’s join Vietlook travel to review the delicious and attractive dishes in Da Nang such as: Grilled Bei Cau Mong, Nam O Fish Salad, Rice Paper Rolls with Pork, Cao Lau…

1. Quang Noodles

A dish that is no longer strange to the people of the Central region, Quang noodles with meat, raw vegetables, dried rice paper, and peanuts mixed together bring diners the delicious and famous flavor of the Central region’s cuisine.

2. Bun Mam Nem

A dish that you only try once but will remember forever, with the combination of young jackfruit, the aroma of raw vegetables, the fatty taste of roasted peanuts, it looks quite simple but when enjoyed, it will be quite delicious and attractive.

3. Cau Mong Grilled Veal

The veal is grilled on a charcoal stove until cooked, bringing a characteristic aroma, served with small chewy rice rolls, green banana, sour star fruit, bean sprouts, mixed with dipping sauce to bring a delicious flavor, an indispensable dish for any tourist when going on a Da Nang tour..

4. Nam O Fish Salad

There are usually 2 types of wet salad and dry salad, dry salad for first-time diners, wet salad for gourmets, a must-try dish when having the opportunity to set foot in Da Nang.

5. Pork Roll Rice Paper

A famous specialty in Da Nang, for any tourist when going on a Da Nang tour, this attractive dish cannot be missed, thinly sliced ​​pork, choose both lean and fatty meat, boiled and rolled with raw vegetables, fish sauce to create an unforgettable flavor of Central cuisine.

6. Cao Lau

The dish is very elaborately prepared, with chewy noodles that still retain their softness when eaten with firm pork, crispy skin, rich broth that brings a delicious flavor of its own, an indispensable dish on the journey to Da Nang Hoi An.

7. Banh Dap

A light dish chosen by many diners when traveling to Da Nang, the rice paper is crispy on the outside and wet on the inside, the cake is eaten with a separate dipping sauce, combining softness and toughness to bring a delicious duck flavor.

8. Nem Tre

A dish with a strong Central flavor, visitors can enjoy it on the spot or buy it as a gift. Nem Tre is made from lean pork, boiled pork belly, thinly sliced, mixed together to bring an irresistible delicious flavor.

With the top 8 delicious dishes in Da Nang that Vietlook has just shared above, we hope you will have the opportunity to fully enjoy the cuisine of Ha Thanh during your trip, and if you are choosing for yourself a fun trip to Da Nang, please join us today.
